title: Profile setup bank selection + OTP mobile verification

requirements.summary: Replace SIM-number verification in Profile Setup with a bank-selection + OTP request/verify flow tied to the entered mobile number, and gate profile submission on successful OTP verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile setup screen includes inputs for bank selection, bank account number, and mobile number, plus OTP request + OTP entry + OTP verification controls.
The 'Continue' / submit button remains disabled until bank is selected, account number is non-empty, mobile number is non-empty, and OTP is verified successfully.
Changing the mobile number after requesting/verifying OTP resets OTP state (e.g., clears challenge/verified status and disables submit until re-verified).
All user-facing text is in English and does not rely on emoji to convey meaning.
The previous 'Device SIM' mock display and SIM mismatch logic are removed from the Profile Setup screen.

file_operations.description: Remove mock 'Device SIM' generation/display and SIM mismatch verification logic. Add OTP verification UI and state: bank selection (keep existing Select), bank account number input, mobile number input, 'Send OTP' action, OTP code input, and 'Verify OTP' action. Gate 'Continue' on selected bank + non-empty account number + non-empty mobile number + otpVerified===true. Ensure changing mobile number resets OTP state (clears entered code, clears any demo code/helper text, clears verified flag, and re-disables submit). Ensure all user-facing text remains English and contains no emoji. Use existing composed UI components (Button/Input/Label/Alert/Select) without modifying any files under frontend/src/components/ui.

requirements.summary: Add React Query mutations for starting and verifying OTP challenges and wire them into ProfileSetupScreen with loading/error states and demo-friendly OTP display.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts includes new mutations/hooks for starting an OTP challenge and verifying an OTP.
ProfileSetupScreen uses the new hooks and shows appropriate disabled/loading states for 'Send OTP' and 'Verify OTP' actions.
On OTP request, the UI provides a way to proceed with verification in a demo environment (e.g., displaying the returned OTP in a toast or inline helper text), without implying real SMS delivery.
Errors from OTP request/verify are surfaced to the user in English via existing toast/alert patterns.

file_operations.description: Add React Query mutations/hooks for OTP flow using the existing backend actor methods (startOtpChallenge and verifyOtp). Include loading/error handling and surface failures via the existing toast pattern (sonner). For demo behavior, ensure the OTP-request mutation provides the OTP code to the UI in a non-SMS, explicitly demo-friendly way (e.g., expose returned code/metadata from the mutation result so the screen can show it).

Wire new OTP hooks into the Profile Setup flow: implement 'Send OTP' and 'Verify OTP' buttons with disabled states (e.g., disable send when mobile is empty or request is pending; disable verify when no code entered or verify is pending). Show clear loading text while pending. On successful OTP request, display demo OTP info inline or via toast without implying SMS delivery. Surface errors from OTP request/verify via existing toast/alert patterns in English, and allow retry by re-enabling actions after failures.
